title: Indian Atlas 034 SW · 1878
source: sources/zenodo-19431985/sheets/034 SW Quarter Sheet Indian Atlas (1878).jpg
condition_note: Intact SW quarter with colored boundaries and dense central hill shading. Native publication confirms March 1878. Own printed graticule and frame measured.
line_slope_bounds_reason: Native graticule crops show nearly vertical meridians and gently tilted parallels within these bounds.
longitude_convention_status: The sheet prints -69″ and a further 181.5″ correction to Madras 80°14′19.5″, implying a total westward shift of -250.5″. The user-selected working adjustment remains -216.18″, 34.32″ east of that total; modern datum alignment remains provisional.
longitude_correction_basis: Native margin gives Atlas-to-old-GTS correction -69 arcseconds and a further reduction of 181.5 arcseconds to Madras 80d14m19.5s. Retain user-selected working second correction -147.18 arcseconds, total -216.18; this differs from the printed-convention total -250.5 by +34.32 arcseconds.

printed_longitude_note.transcription: All Longitudes require a correction of -1′-9″, to reduce them to the origin of the Great Trigonometrical Survey: viz: the Madras Observatory taken as 80°17′21″ and a further correction of 3′1″.5, to reduce them to the latest value 80°14′19″.5, of that Observatory.
printed_longitude_note.interpretation_note: The second correction is read as westward from the stated change 80°17′21″ to 80°14′19.5″.

seed_north_latitude_reason: Optimizer seed only: line 1000 on the western meridian is about 836 pixels north of the measured 25.5-degree crossing, or approximately 0.163 degrees using the printed five-minute tick spacing. The generic 25.7-degree seed put southern controls outside the transcribed table before optimization.
frame_stroke_width_reason: Native southwest corner review shows dense hill hachures adjoining the western and southern inner rules. Cap inward dark-stroke extension at two pixels on those edges before the four-pixel inset, preserving map shading that would otherwise be treated as extra frame thickness.
